scope: Real offline workbench DOM, production Worker/WebGL; not React/Vite certification.

tests.name: New bounded enlargement default is explicit in the UI
Cavity search is on by default with four growth steps
Actual medium garment loads as structured panels before budget feedback
Actual 3D seams follow longitudinal plane, not old zigzag partition
Source UV is not present in runtime input
Actual fill button transmits cavity settings to production Worker
Filling preserves islands, seam edges and valid actual triangles
UI reports real stopping reason, gap metric and geometric occupancy separately
Committed coordinates, summary and table report the same area gain
Area is not mislabeled as edge-length enlargement
Changing a density preset never starts a hidden fill or discards the result
UV fill does not change user camera
Largest empty window decreases without shrinking input charts
Animation endpoint equals the repacked target
Picking still selects the island before any triangle
Controls do not silently rerun generation
